# Hibiscus 0.8.31

This update fixes AI menu outlines, keeps your license key private by default,
and remembers your chosen Dock icon after quitting.

- Opening the editor AI menu or the assistant Plus menu no longer draws a blue
  outline around the entire panel. Escape still closes the menu and returns
  focus to the editor or message input.
- Your license key is hidden by default in Settings. Click the masked key or
  eye icon to reveal it; hide it again with the eye icon. It is hidden again
  when you leave the details screen or the app becomes inactive.
- Your selected app icon stays in the Dock after you quit Hibiscus. Changes in
  Appearance settings update the Dock icon immediately, while Finder keeps
  the original Hibiscus icon.

No note migration or API-key re-entry is required.
